WITH input AS (SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id),
beats AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'scene_id',s.id,'scene_number',s.scene_number,'narration',s.narration,'narration_support_evidence_ids',s.narration_support_evidence_ids,
    'beat_start_seconds',s.beat_start_seconds,'beat_end_seconds',s.beat_end_seconds,'duration_seconds',s.duration_seconds,'status',s.status
  ) ORDER BY s.scene_number),'[]'::jsonb) AS rows,
  count(*)::int AS count
  FROM public.scenes s,input WHERE s.job_id=input.job_id
),
segments AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'segment_id',vs.id,'segment_number',vs.segment_number,'first_scene_number',vs.first_scene_number,'last_scene_number',vs.last_scene_number,
    'start_seconds',vs.start_seconds,'end_seconds',vs.end_seconds,'duration_seconds',vs.duration_seconds,'planned_shot_count',vs.planned_shot_count,'status',vs.status
  ) ORDER BY vs.segment_number),'[]'::jsonb) AS rows,
  count(*)::int AS count
  FROM public.visual_segments vs,input WHERE vs.job_id=input.job_id
),
shots AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'shot_id',sh.id,'shot_number',sh.shot_number,'segment_number',vs.segment_number,'segment_shot_number',sh.segment_shot_number,
    'start_seconds',sh.start_seconds,'end_seconds',sh.end_seconds,'duration_seconds',sh.duration_seconds,'visual_path',sh.local_path,
    'visual_cluster_key',sh.visual_cluster_key,'visual_kind',sh.visual_kind,'selection_score',sh.selection_score,
    'asset_key',a.provider||':'||a.provider_asset_id,'asset_metadata',a.metadata
  ) ORDER BY sh.shot_number),'[]'::jsonb) AS rows,
  count(*)::int AS count
  FROM public.visual_shots sh
  JOIN public.visual_segments vs ON vs.id=sh.visual_segment_id
  JOIN public.media_library_assets a ON a.id=sh.media_library_asset_id
  JOIN input ON sh.job_id=input.job_id
)
SELECT input.job_id AS requested_job_id,j.id AS job_id,j.language_code,j.target_duration_seconds,j.content_model_version,
       j.voiceover_path,j.voiceover_duration_seconds,j.status,j.current_stage,j.final_video_path,j.last_error,j.visual_quality,j.id IS NOT NULL AS job_exists,
       beats.count AS scene_count,beats.rows AS scenes,segments.count AS visual_segment_count,segments.rows AS visual_segments,
       shots.count AS visual_shot_count,shots.rows AS visual_shots
FROM input
LEFT JOIN public.jobs j ON j.id=input.job_id
CROSS JOIN beats CROSS JOIN segments CROSS JOIN shots;

WITH transitioned AS (
  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET
    current_stage = 'render',
    last_error = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND status = 'processing'
    AND current_stage = 'visuals'
  RETURNING id, status, current_stage
),
resumed AS (
  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET
    status = 'processing',
    current_stage = 'render',
    last_error = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND status = 'failed'
    AND current_stage = 'render'
  RETURNING id, status, current_stage
),
existing AS (
  SELECT id, status, current_stage
  FROM public.jobs
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND status = 'processing'
    AND current_stage = 'render'
),
ready AS (
  SELECT id, status, current_stage, true AS started_now FROM transitioned
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, status, current_stage, true AS started_now FROM resumed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, status, current_stage, false AS started_now FROM existing
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  $1::uuid AS job_id,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ready) AS ready_to_run,
  (SELECT status FROM ready LIMIT 1) AS status,
  (SELECT current_stage FROM ready LIMIT 1) AS current_stage,
  COALESCE((SELECT started_now FROM ready LIMIT 1), false) AS started_now;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET final_video_path=$2::text,visual_quality=$3::jsonb,status='review_ready',current_stage='review',last_error=NULL,updated_at=now()
  WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='processing' AND current_stage='render' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(final_video_path),'') IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(($3::jsonb->>'pass')::boolean,false)=true
  RETURNING id,status,current_stage,final_video_path
), existing AS (
  SELECT id,status,current_stage,final_video_path FROM public.jobs
  WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='review_ready' AND current_stage='review' AND final_video_path=$2::text
    AND COALESCE((visual_quality->>'pass')::boolean,false)=true
), ready AS (
  SELECT id,status,current_stage,final_video_path,true AS transitioned FROM updated
  UNION ALL SELECT id,status,current_stage,final_video_path,false AS transitioned FROM existing LIMIT 1
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ready) AS persisted,COALESCE((SELECT transitioned FROM ready LIMIT 1),false) AS transitioned,
 (SELECT status FROM ready LIMIT 1) AS status,(SELECT current_stage FROM ready LIMIT 1) AS current_stage,(SELECT final_video_path FROM ready LIMIT 1) AS final_video_path;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET
    status = 'failed',
    current_stage = 'render',
    last_error = CASE
      WHEN status = 'failed' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(last_error), '') IS NOT NULL THEN last_error
      ELSE LEFT($2::text, 4000)
    END,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND current_stage = 'render'
    AND status IN ('processing', 'failed')
  RETURNING id, status, current_stage, last_error
)
SELECT
  $1::uuid AS job_id,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) AS failure_recorded,
  (SELECT status FROM updated LIMIT 1) AS status,
  (SELECT current_stage FROM updated LIMIT 1) AS current_stage,
  COALESCE((SELECT last_error FROM updated LIMIT 1), LEFT($2::text, 4000)) AS last_error;
